paragraphs.text:
Normally all violent
encounters are worth 1
XP, but some monsters may be
worth more. Remember that you
claim a monster’s XP value you
must defeat it. If you run away,
you gain no XP. Defeating some
monsters may give you rewards
other than XP to choose from, for
example a monster may give you
the option to choose between
gaining 2 XP or gaining 1 Clue when
you defeat it.
